# Assumption of Moses Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** Joshua's Lament Over Moses

---

**11:1** And when Joshua had heard these things, he tore his garments and fell at the feet of Moses and began to mourn for him, saying:

**11:2** O Moses, why have you comforted me? And how shall I be able to remain without you?

**11:3** Who will provide food for this many people? Or who will be their shepherd?

**11:4** Who will have compassion on them and will lead them in the way they should go?

**11:5** Who will pray on their behalf when they have sinned and will intercede for them?

**11:6** Behold, the land will be distributed to them, and they will set their hearts on good things.

**11:7** But when they are in the land they will sin and not keep the commandments of the Lord, just as their fathers did.

**11:8** And who will make intercession for them and ask forgiveness of their sins?

**11:9** For their God will be angry at them and will not spare them.

**11:10** He will destroy their root from the land and will scatter them to the nations.

**11:11** How then will they endure the nations? For they will not rule over them.

**11:12** How will they cry to the Lord, who is the Most High God, and who has power over all?

**11:13** And how will they be able to dwell in the land, not having a man to make intercession for them?

**11:14** For behold, you are going away from us, and where will those who fear God find comfort?

**11:15** For what nations will not rejoice when they hear of your departure, and will not say: let us go against them and destroy them from the earth?

**11:16** For Moses, the holy prophet and servant of God, is gone from among them.
